content.text: Rim only 0.7. Wait for enemies near a wall. Move to the south wall? Enemies come from back and sides; fight near the south wall.
Enemies don't seem to approach quickly. Attack the nearest.
Punch the one winding up at northeast (it's about to strike); use kick for stagger.
I'm fighting a pack of three weakened fodder enemies and losing health, so I'm closing in on them to land hits.
Held one. Throw it at the others.
I'm at 20 HP, so I'm switching to grab-and-throw, which kills them without letting them hit me.
Enemy is winding up; grab and throw it.

I died in box 1 after about 21 seconds, with 4 kills and no boxes escaped.

The fodder enemies hit me from about 1.5 m, which is farther than my punches reached. My health dropped from 100 to 0 over the fight. Grabbing an enemy and throwing it was the only thing that killed reliably. I worked that out too late to recover.
